'''Finn Varatha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who renowned for her expertise at disguise, able to appear as friends and loved ones of her targets.<ref name="Small Favors" />

She was an associate of [[Cryle Cavv]], and assisted Cavv and [[Quillin Arkell]] in their efforts to [[Skirmish on Corulag|rescue]] [[Rivoche Tarkin]] from [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Central Commander]] [[Sollaine]].<ref name="Small Favors" />

Following the rescue, Cavv got [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to assign Arkell and Varatha to his newly reinstated [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Ops]] group.<ref name="Small Favors" />
